Selling into an uptrend with a tight stop (₹1.73 risk) in a strong momentum stock made the SL hit almost inevitable. The zone score of 41/60 was far too low to justify a counter-trend position.
regime_impact: The trending_up regime hurt the SELL trade significantly. TATASTEEL moved with the broader market uptrend, invalidating the supply zone. The regime should have been a hard filter against SELL setups, especially those with 0% AI probability. Only BUY setups aligned with the regime should have been placed.

improvements.action: Hard-block any SELL orders when regime is trending_up and AI probability is below 30%. Never place orders with 0% AI probability regardless of any other factor.
improvements.reason: TATASTEEL SELL had 0% AI probability and was counter-trend — this was a guaranteed loss that should never have been placed.

improvements.action: Set minimum zone score threshold to 48/60 before placing any order. If fewer than 1 setup qualifies, skip the day entirely rather than force low-quality trades.
improvements.reason: Both setups today scored 41-42/60, well below reliable levels. Forcing trades on thin setup days led to a ₹-1000 loss with no upside potential.

improvements.action: When only 1-2 setups are available across all 50 stocks, treat it as a 'no-trade day' unless at least one setup has AI probability ≥ 55% AND zone score ≥ 50/60.
improvements.reason: Low setup count (2/50) signals lack of clear opportunity. Today's decision to lower thresholds in trending_up regime backfired — quality over quantity must be enforced.
